title: Shrink hook-enforced rules to signposts and run the regen chain
action: Rules already enforced by a hook or a test are restated across files: gates belong to the user (6 sites), gate-before-source (4), CLI-only state (4), reservation conflicts (4), red refuses the cap (3), docs/specs read-only (3), the scout read guard (1, self-admittedly redundant), AskUserQuestion schema (harness-enforced). Keep one canonical home each — AGENTS.md for the boundary rules, gates-and-delegation for gate mechanics, scout-and-ticks for the spec fence — and reduce every other site to a single pointer line. Then run the wave-close regen: bee dev render-skill-trees, bee onboard --repo-root . --apply, bee dev release-manifest --write, in that order.

truths: each enforced rule has exactly one full statement
every other mention is one line
rendered projections and the manifest match the sources
